source: doc/src/content/docs/overview/board-b-synth-power.md (DC-DC Conversion Stage, Linear Regulator Stage net tables) cross-checked against doc/src/content/docs/inbox/board-split-decision.md (locked #90 fix list, item 6: Net-(C16-Pad2) -> GND merge)
notes: Derived from the netlist-derived doc tables, NOT re-derived from .kicad_sch wire geometry.
Pin tokens strip parenthetical pin-name glosses from the doc (e.g. doc 'U6.1(IN)' -> baseline 'U6.1'); the token itself is always Ref.PinNumberOrName.

GND includes the #90/#93-locked fix: C16.2, C24.1, C19.2, C25.1 merged from the old isolated Net-(C16-Pad2) into GND (board-split-decision.md A6 item 6; board-b-synth-power.md Linear Regulator Stage 'Negative-rail decoupling' note).
Output Connectors (J6-J11), Protection-stage second pins (PTC1.2/PTC2.2/PTC3.2), and TVS1-3 are intentionally NOT included in nets below -- see unresolved.

unresolved.reason: board-b-synth-power.md Protection Stage / Output Connectors only give PTC1.1 in Ref.Pin form (see Net-(U6-OUT) above). PTC1.2, TVS1, J7 Faston tabs, and J10/J11 pins 7-8 are documented only via a Ref-only Faston table, a pin-range Eurorack table, and a mermaid block diagram -- no Ref.Pin net table entry exists to baseline without guessing pin numbers.
Same gap as +12V rail: PTC2.2, TVS2, J8, and J10/J11 pins 5-6 have no Ref.Pin net-table entry in board-b-synth-power.md, only Ref-only/pin-range tables and the mermaid block diagram.
Same gap as +12V rail: PTC3.2, TVS3, J6, and J10/J11 pins 15-16 have no Ref.Pin net-table entry in board-b-synth-power.md, only Ref-only/pin-range tables and the mermaid block diagram.
board-b-synth-power.md's J10/J11 table lists pins 1-2 as an isolated stub ('nothing else on this net') with no Ref.Pin data, and does not disambiguate J10 vs J11 physical-pin identity.
Same as GATE rail: J10/J11 pins 3-4 documented only as an isolated stub, no Ref.Pin data, J10/J11 identity not disambiguated.

unresolved.reason: board-b-synth-power.md gives J9/J10/J11 GND membership only via a Ref-only Faston table and a pin-range Eurorack table, not Ref.Pin tokens, and does not disambiguate J10 vs J11 pin numbering -- merging into the already-resolved GND net above would require guessing which physical pins are meant.

unresolved.net: GND (DC-DC stage pins implied by prose, not enumerated in the Ref.Pin net tables: C3.2, C4.2, C11.1, R5.2, C33.2)
unresolved.reason: board-b-synth-power.md's 'Feedback dividers' table/formula states R5 (U4's bottom FB resistor) lands on GND, and standard bulk-decoupling-cap / feedforward-cap topology implies C3.2 (U2 output cap), C4.2 (U3 output cap), C11.1 (U4 output-side bulk cap, opposite plate from the already-listed C11.2 on the -13.5V OUT net), and C33.2 (mirrors R5.2, feedforward cap across R5) also land on GND -- but the DC-DC stage's own U2/U3/U4 Ref.Pin net tables never list these five pins explicitly. Adding them to the resolved GND net above would extrapolate beyond the literal doc table per the 'never guess connectivity' rule. A real complete spec module correctly wiring these five pins to GND will be flagged as 'extra pins' by check_baseline.py until this doc gap is closed or an --allow entry covers them; that is expected, not a spec bug.
